name: @maronn-openid-connect/sample-nextjs-vercel
description: Next.js sample app with OpenID Provider code generated by the CLI

scripts.generate: maronn-oidc generate nextjs --enable device-authorization-grant --enable ciba --enable google-login --output ./src/app --force
scripts.launch: pnpm run build && pnpm run start
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @maronn-openid-connect/core --filter @maronn-openid-connect/experimental --filter @maronn-openid-connect/google-login run build && pnpm run typecheck
